description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) file defining build instructions for the 'runc' container CLI tool within a Yocto-based build environment. It specifies dependencies, configuration options, build steps, and install commands for the container runtime component.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Custom build step that sets up the GOPATH, creates symlinks, and calls make to build either static or dynamic runc binary based on configuration.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the 'runc' binary into the designated directory and creates a symlink for 'docker-runc'.
